purpose: Internal atomic Schedule placement mutation used only after B04-D movement governance and hard-admissibility checks have passed.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Appends one new absolute Schedule placement MaterialState after exact expected-state CAS.
state_history.current_binding: Atomically moves scoped_current_material_state from the expected placement state to the new state.
state_history.chronology: Closes the prior open placement history episode and opens a monotonic new episode.
state_history.immutability_policy: Prior placement MaterialState payload is never rewritten.

lifecycle.retention: Schedule placement history remains reconstructible after movement.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No delete path; this function only appends and advances canonical placement currentness.

obligations: current/history transition is atomic and monotonic
runtime cannot bypass movement governance by executing this helper directly
